newsitem.title: USA: US Stockpile says credit cards no longer accepted.
newsitem.headline: US Stockpile says credit cards no longer accepted.

text.p: No more putting it on the plastic for happy commodity shoppers at the U.S. Stockpile's mall for surplus metals.
Defense National Stockpile Center announced Thursday it will stop accepting credit cards in payment for Stockpile commodities because it does not make financial sense.

"While we regret any inconvenience to our customers, the Department of the Treasury has informed us that the cost of the credit card program exceeds the benefits derived by the government," Stockpile administrator Richard Connelly said.
